vocabulary_focus.concept: To innovate / To develop new things

expressions.en: To innovate / To develop something new
expressions.cn: 创新 / 开发新事物 (chuàngxīn / kāifā xīn shìwù)
数据分析 / 数据洞察 (shùjù fēnxī / shùjù dòngchá)
用户友好 / 易于使用 (yònghù yǒuhǎo / yì yú shǐyòng)

work.scenario: During a project meeting, your manager says: 'In our next quarter, we need to focus on **developing a new online portal** to enhance customer experience. This is part of our broader **digital transformation** strategy. We also need to **upgrade our existing CRM system** based on the **data analysis** from last year's performance. Our goal is to ensure **sustainable development** for the company.'

life.scenario: You're chatting with a friend about new gadgets and community initiatives: 'My new phone is great, I **upgraded** it last month and the interface is so **user-friendly**. I heard our local council is also looking into **sustainable development** projects for the neighbourhood, like better waste management.'

tech.scenario: At a tech startup's brainstorming session, the lead developer states: 'Our challenge is to **innovate** our core product to stay ahead. The market demands a seamless **digital transformation** experience, so we must ensure our new features are truly **user-friendly**. We'll rely on **data insights** to guide our future **development**.'
